card.name: Phrases of refusing to put up with something
card.fires_on: Words in phrases about no longer putting up with something, such as 'enough is enough', 'will no longer tolerate', 'tired of' and 'must end'. Mostly in opinion or political web text.

modes.description: The verb or repeated word inside the saying 'enough is enough'.
